data.title: About Meridian
data.excerpt: Meridian is an industrial engineering partner. We stay close to the work: the drawings, the commissioning, and the team that runs the plant afterwards.

props.headline: A Thai engineering partner built for an industrial decade.
props.body: We began as a small controls and electrical team in Bangkok. Today we work across automation, software, infrastructure, and data, with the same discipline: engineering has to work in a real shift.

image.alt: Industrial robotic arm on an engineering bench

props.heading: What precision looks like here.
props.body: We judge system quality by whether the client team can run the system after handover.

items.title: Precision without theatre
items.description: The best work is quiet, reliable, and explainable.

items.title: Traceable decisions
items.description: We write down assumptions and evidence so decisions outlive the people who made them.

items.title: Capability transfer
items.description: Success is measured by the client team running the system without us.

items.title: Long-view partnership
items.description: We choose relationships that survive change over short-term margin.

props.heading: Experience that can be measured.

items.title: Digital systems practice
items.description: Software, data, and integration capability consolidated under one team.

items.title: Regional collaboration
items.description: A Singapore liaison office supports cross-border industrial programmes.

props.heading: Accountable at every layer.
props.intro: Sample leadership profiles for this fictional portfolio brand. Roles and biographies are demonstration content.

items.name: Anan Srisuk
items.bio: Anan leads Meridian's operating agenda and its long-term partnership model. He has spent two decades connecting industrial operations with engineering delivery.

items.name: Pimchanok Rattanaporn
items.bio: Pimchanok owns delivery quality, commercial discipline, and the systems that let distributed engineering teams work as one practice.

items.name: Daniel Lim
items.bio: Daniel sets the technical architecture for automation, integration, and operational data. He is accountable for engineering standards across the group.

items.name: Nattaya Boonsong
items.bio: Nattaya leads control and robotics delivery, with a focus on brownfield upgrades that keep production running.

items.name: Marcus Chen
items.bio: Marcus brings software, integration, and data engineering into one practice, with an emphasis on operator adoption.

items.name: Siriporn Khamdee
items.bio: Siriporn builds the apprenticeship, safety, and capability programmes that let engineers grow without losing field discipline.

props.body: We look for engineers and managers who want to work where technical precision meets business outcome.
